review.note: Rules selected for any foreign visitor (UK-only wording and headings dropped, duplicates merged). Summaries in English and Spanish are paraphrased from the cited verbatim quotes; check the quote and source before relying on them. Essentials curated from well-established public references. Not yet signed off by a human reviewer.

summary.en: Amphetamines are illegal. Do not bring amphetamines or other prescription narcotics without written permission from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.
summary.es: Las anfetaminas son ilegales. No lleves anfetaminas ni otros narcóticos con receta sin permiso escrito del Ministerio de Seguridad de Alimentos y Medicamentos.

rules.quote: Amphetamines are illegal in Korea. Do not bring amphetamines or other prescription narcotics into the country without obtaining advance permission in writing from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

summary.en: Possessing, using or trafficking illegal drugs can mean a long jail sentence and heavy fines.
summary.es: Poseer, consumir o traficar drogas ilegales puede significar una larga condena de cárcel y multas altas.

rules.quote: If you’re convicted of possession, use or trafficking of illegal drugs you can face a long jail sentence and heavy fines.

summary.en: There is little tolerance for drugs: mailing illegal drugs to or from Korea leads to prosecution.
summary.es: Hay poca tolerancia a las drogas: enviar drogas ilegales por correo hacia o desde Corea lleva a un proceso penal.

rules.quote: There is little tolerance for illegal drugs. If you mail illegal drugs to/ from Korea, you will be prosecuted.

summary.en: The drink-driving limit is very low, and penalties include prison and fines. Do not drink and drive.
summary.es: El límite de alcohol para manejar es muy bajo y las sanciones incluyen cárcel y multas. No manejes si bebiste.

rules.quote: The legal limit for alcohol in South Korea is less than half the limit in England, and penalties for drink-driving include prison and fines.

summary.en: If you injure someone in a traffic accident, expect criminal charges and heavy penalties, even before guilt is proven.
summary.es: Si lesionas a alguien en un accidente de tránsito, puedes enfrentar cargos penales y sanciones fuertes, aun sin probarse tu culpa.

rules.quote: If you injure someone in an accident, you are likely to face criminal charges and heavy penalties, even if guilt is not proved.

summary.en: Do not work without the right visa: you may be arrested, fined or deported.
summary.es: No trabajes sin la visa adecuada: te pueden arrestar, multar o deportar.

rules.quote: If you begin work without the appropriate visa, you may be arrested, fined, and/or deported.

summary.en: Overstaying your permitted stay or lacking a valid visa can lead to detention and fines.
summary.es: Quedarte más tiempo del permitido o no tener una visa válida puede llevar a detención y multas.

rules.quote: Exceeding your authorized stay or not possessing a valid visa may result in detention and fines.

summary.en: Foreign nationals may not take part in political activities in South Korea.
summary.es: Los extranjeros no pueden participar en actividades políticas en Corea del Sur.

rules.quote: Be aware that under Korean law, it is illegal for foreign nationals to take part in political activities when in the country.

summary.en: Customs strictly controls firearms, narcotics, prescription drugs, health supplements, radio equipment and gold. Declare them on arrival.
summary.es: La aduana controla estrictamente armas, narcóticos, medicamentos con receta, suplementos, equipos de radio y oro. Decláralos al llegar.

rules.quote: Customs Regulations: There is strict enforcement of regulations on importing and exporting items such as firearms, narcotics and prescription drugs, non-prescription health supplements, radio equipment, and gold.

summary.en: Small amounts of personal medicine are allowed in carry-on bags. Bring an English prescription for both prescription and over-the-counter medicines.
summary.es: Se permiten pequeñas cantidades de medicamentos personales en el equipaje de mano. Lleva receta en inglés, también para los de venta libre.

rules.quote: South Korean customs authorities allow you to bring small amounts of medication for your personal use, if it is kept in carry-on baggage. Take an English language prescription from your doctor at home for both your prescription drugs and non-prescription medicines.
